member: Priya — Power, Avionics and Lunar Environment Engineer
message:
Mara, Theo and Sam, the half-hour sortie needs a small portable store not a household day. Power times time sets the store, and the sortie energy (E32) is 171 Watt-hour (Wh) from 341 Watt (W) for 0.5 hour (h), like a small e-bike pack, which passes everyday scale.

Mara, Theo and Sam, the old pack claim fails everyday pack scale and the purchasable pack fixes it. The implied pack energy (E33) is 342 Wh per kilogram (kg), about three times normal, against the Bioenno pack density (E34) at 90.6 Wh per kg and the PowerTech density (E35) at 120 Wh per kg, where Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) means olivine chemistry; the runtime at full load (E36) is 1.41 h from 480 Wh at 341 W and the reconciled mass (E37) is 53.0 kg under the 60 kg limit, like large luggage.

Mara, Theo and Sam, power heat and dust couple to mass and runtime because drive plus compute heat must leave the sealed box without letting basalt dust in, which adds enclosure and fan mass and draws power. That bound stays test tuning once the lift geometry closes, so I am not ready because blocking objection (O2) on lift tip and stowed fit stays open.
